Completely show the full body of the character in T-pose. Standing upright, facing forward. Arms raise horizontally at shoulder height. Palms facing down, remove handheld objects but keep hand-worn equipment and accessories. Legs straight, feet shoulder-width apart. Keep natural body proportions and anatomy. Front view, neutral background.
A new character: an amateur football player, a white man in his early thirties, a dashing and cocky quarterback, quick and nimble but not strong: lean and wiry with narrow hips, long legs, thin arms and his chest pushed out, standing very upright, wearing old white canvas sneakers. His head and face are exactly those of the man in image[1], which shows the same head twice: bald and smooth on top with short neat black hair round the sides and back only, a big black handlebar moustache with thick curled tips, strong jaw, one eyebrow raised, a confident closed-mouth smirk. He wears exactly the same kit as the character in image[2] (white jersey, grey pants, dark grey socks up to the pants) and is made in exactly the same hand-sculpted clay art style, surface texture, level of detail, lighting and background as image[2], but is a different person with a different body. Full body, front view, standing upright in a T-pose with arms straight out to the sides, palms down, fingers slightly apart, legs slightly apart. Stylized 3D cartoon character, an everyday person rather than an athlete, with a slightly big head, slightly oversized hands and shoes, smooth matte clay look, a detailed and expressive face, sculpted chunky hair, soft folds in the clothes, and well-defined hands, elbows and knees. The kit: a loose short-sleeved football jersey in plain near-white, pants ending just below the knee in plain mid grey, long socks in plain dark grey, each one flat colour with no logos, no numbers, no text, no stripes and no trim in another colour. Bare arms and bare hands, no helmet, no pads. Mouth closed. Matte, no gloss. Flat, even lighting. Single isolated figure on a plain flat blue-grey background, no floor shadow, no props.
